plugin.note: Melee is most effective. Use Protect from Melee with high prayer bonus armour; watch Night beast specials and stay in melee range so it does not use extra standard magic attacks.

requirements: 90 combat to be assigned unless assignment difficulty has been disabled
Song of the Elves for Iorwerth Dungeon
Need More Darkness unlock for 110-135 task sizes
Bigger and Badder unlock for Night beast superior spawns
mechanics: Dark beasts can be killed with Melee, Magic, or Ranged, but Melee is most effective.
Dark beasts remain permanently aggressive and do not become tolerant.
Dark beasts use Magic as their first attack only if the player attacks first or if they cannot attack with Melee.
Use Protect from Melee because Dark beasts have highly accurate melee attacks.
Dark beasts have a 60% elemental weakness to earth spells, but the task page recommends melee for normal tasking.
Night beasts are superior variants; they are not aggressive, so the player normally causes the first standard magic attack by attacking them.
Night beast special attack fires three 3x3 magic hits for one third of current Hitpoints, rounded down.
Iorwerth Dungeon Dark beasts can drop crystal shards.
Dark beasts and Night beasts are the only monsters that drop the dark bow and death talisman.

methods.label: Melee general
methods.summary: Use strong melee weapons with Protect from Melee for the fastest general Dark beast task method.
recommendedFor: Players using standard offensive melee gear
Iorwerth Dungeon or Mourner Tunnels tasks
steps: Enter Iorwerth Dungeon or Mourner Tunnels and set up in melee range.
Keep Protect from Melee active because Dark beasts have accurate melee attacks.
Use the best available melee weapon; Scythe of vitur, Soulreaper axe, Ghrazi rapier, Blade of saeldor, Osmumten's fang, Noxious halberd, and Zamorakian hasta are documented melee options.
Use special attacks for faster kills where supplies allow.
Let normal Dark beasts stay aggressive and continue attacking without needing aggression resets.
risks: If the player stands out of melee range, Dark beasts can use Magic.
Night beasts require more attention than regular Dark beasts.

methods.label: Melee prayer bonus
methods.summary: Use high prayer bonus armour to reduce prayer potion drain while camping Protect from Melee.
steps: Wear high prayer bonus armour such as Sunfire fanatic armour or proselyte armour.
Keep Protect from Melee active for the full task.
Use Saradomin godsword special attacks to restore prayer and hitpoints when available.
Use Lightbearer, Ring of the gods (i), Holy wrench, Prayer cape, or bonecrusher necklace where they fit the setup.
Trade some melee damage for lower prayer drain when attention or supply cost matters.
notes: The task page specifically recommends high prayer bonus armour to reduce prayer point drain.

methods.label: Iorwerth Dungeon
methods.summary: Use the Iorwerth Dungeon for cannonable single-combat kills with crystal shard drops.
recommendedFor: Players with Song of the Elves complete
steps: Travel to the Iorwerth Dungeon Dark beast area.
Set up a dwarf multicannon in the single-combat room.
Kill with melee and Protect from Melee.
Loot crystal shards when they drop.
notes: The task page lists 10 Dark beasts in Iorwerth Dungeon.
Dark beasts killed in Iorwerth Dungeon have a chance to drop crystal shards.

methods.label: Mourner Tunnels
methods.summary: Use Mourner Tunnels for the larger Dark beast room and convenient Slayer ring access.
recommendedFor: Players after simple cannonable Dark beast kills
steps: Use a Slayer ring to teleport directly to the Mourner Tunnels Dark beasts after completing Mourning's End Part II.
Alternatively reach them through the Death Altar via the Abyss or through Mourner Headquarters.
Set up a dwarf multicannon and kill with melee.
Keep Protect from Melee active.
notes: The task page lists 19 Dark beasts in Mourner Tunnels.

methods.label: Night beast
methods.summary: Handle Night beast by staying in melee range, keeping Protect from Melee active, and accepting the special magic hits.
recommendedFor: Superior Slayer encounters after Bigger and Badder
steps: Attack the Night beast and expect a standard magic attack because it is not aggressive.
Move into and remain in melee range.
Keep Protect from Melee active.
When the Night beast briefly stops attacking, let the three 3x3 special magic attacks hit while staying in melee range.
Eat as needed; the special deals one third of current Hitpoints rounded down, but normal magic attacks can still hit.
risks: Leaving melee range can cause extra standard magic attacks.
The special attack cannot kill by itself below 3 Hitpoints, but the normal magic attack can still deal damage.
notes: Using a goading potion to aggro the Night beast still results in its standard magic first attack and it will still use its magic special.

methods.label: Inventory
methods.summary: Bring prayer sustain, cannon supplies, alchemy or rune storage, loot containers, and a one-click teleport.
inventory: Saradomin godsword or other spec weapon
2-3 divine super combat potions, super combat potions, or super attack and super strength potions
Rune pouch with High Level Alchemy runes or space for chaos, death, and blood rune drops
Bonecrusher if not using bonecrusher necklace
Holy wrench if not using Ring of the gods (i) or Prayer cape
notes: The task page recommends herb sack and gem bag to maximise profit from Dark beast drops.
